name: PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk
summary: PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk provides consumer financing, murabahah financing, and finance leasing services in Indonesia. It provides solution funds, car and motorcycle loans, and business credit. The company also offers sharia car and motorcycle financing, umrah financing, amanah fund solution and hasanah (hajj plus adira syariah), as well as provides digital solutions. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk.
